Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
OCTOBER 10, 2019 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.

2.

3.

4.
PRESENTATIONS (15 Minutes)
A.
State of the Urban Forest – John Ugrob, Utility & Maintenance Field Supervisor, and Chris Kallstrand, City Arborist.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS/PUBLIC COMMENT Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

A.
Divesting the City of Encinitas from Fossil Fuels. Commissioner Christian Adams
1.
Recommendation to City Council to adopt proposed resolution.
9A_AGENDA REPORT (ADAMS) - Fossil Fuel Divestment
9A_ATTACHMENT 1 - Carbon-Majors-Report-2017
9A_ATTACHMENT 2 - Banking-on-Climate-Change-2019
B.
Summary of Assembly Bill 262 (2017) - Buy Clean California. Commissioner Joy Lyndes
1.
Establish an Environmental Commission Subcommittee to:
a.
Attend the next State Department of General Services (DGS) External Stakeholder Event on Wednesday, October 31, 2019 1:30 p.m. – 4:30 p.m. and research ways to engage with the State DGS as an interested party in the ongoing dialogue to advance the Buy Clean Initiative.
b.
Draft a City of Encinitas resolution to support the objectives and goals of AB 262 Buy Clean California.
c.
Consider amendments to integrate AB262 objectives into the City’s CAP Implementation plan.
d.
Collaborate with the American Institute of Architects (AIA) San Diego and Palomar Chapters to evaluate what the City of Encinitas can do to improve our standards to meet the objectives of AB 262.
